column1: Tab 11 — User Journey: Inputs and Outputs at Every Layer

One row per layer of the journey, in the order the backend runs them (Tab 8). INPUTS are split into what the USER supplies and what the SYSTEM already holds; OUTPUTS are split into what stays INTERNAL to the engine and what the USER sees. The last column states the AI boundary for that layer: rules decide, AI only assists within fixed limits (“bounded AI”). Where AI classifies, it returns a confidence score; below the threshold the user is asked to confirm - it never guesses silently.

column7: Support screen with fixed, clinically reviewed copy and UK crisis routes

column10: Classifier FLAGS risk language (tuned for high recall). It never replies, reassures or decides; copy is fixed.
